entries.text: This newsletter comes from website@thelenches.org.uk. To make sure it keeps reaching your inbox, please add that address to your contacts.

New on the website: a fresh look, events and news from around the Lenches updated daily, church service times with links to each Sunday's Bible readings, and your bin days. Have a look at thelenches.org.uk.

New on the website: a new home page with an illustrated map of the villages, a Notices page for notices and news from around the villages, and a Roads page with a map of closures and roadworks and a slider to see what's on any day in the next 8 weeks.
The menu at the top of every page is now a row of buttons, and on phones a Menu button opens it.
The Events page now shows a picture beside each event. Have a look at what's on.
New on the website: a 'What to do if…' page saying who to call for power cuts, gas leaks, flooding, lost pets, fly-tipping, potholes and blocked footpaths.
You can now join the Thursday newsletter straight from the website: enter your email and click the link we send you.
